name: Effect: metal bar (body)
notes: Your playing shakes a free metal bar (a glockenspiel bar before it is tuned) at C6 (1047 Hz), and it clangs along. An effect for in front of any amp: no amp, no cab, auto level off. Physics: a free bar (Euler-Bernoulli: its modes at 1, 2.76, 5.40, 8.93 x the lowest). Simplified: every mode is shaken and heard equally. Change Lowest mode in the chain editor to tune it.
